answer: An admission auction blocks bulk fakes. Each applicant posts a sealed bid; bids are sorted into price terraces and only the top 200 win a slot, locked for 20 epochs. A beacon publishes a random seed that breaks ties and picks 5% of winners for checks, so forgers cannot predict inspections. The kernel is that every identity must outbid demand: at 40 units each, 100 fakes cost 4,000 units, while honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards.
